text: KALPANA CHAWLA CHHATRAVRATI YOJNA FOR GIRLS SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME 2025-26 HARYANA STATE COUNCIL FOR SCIENCE INNOVATION & TECHNOLOGY, PANCHKULA For Girls who have taken admission in Bachelor of Engineering /Bachelor of Technology, Bachelor of Architecture & Bachelor of Planning courses in the year 2025-26. Last Date : 10.08.2026 NUMBER OF SCHOLARSHIPS : 200 scholarships for students admitted in B.E/B.Tech courses 25 scholarships each for students admitted in Bachelor of Architecture and Bachelor of Planning courses AMOUNT OF SCHOLARSHIPS: Rs. 8350/- per month for students selected on the basis of rank in JEE (Advanced) examination and Rs. 4500/- per month for students selected on the basis on rank in JEE (Mains) examination.
